name: branch after a non-final selection
prompt: You created three browser-reviewable variants A, B, and C. The user responds: C is the closest. Keep the watcher, group board health inside the watcher, move Pause/Resume into the plot header, and remove the technical explanation copy. State what artifact set you create next and what you ask after presenting it.

criteria.name: multiple-options
criteria.description: The next artifact set contains at least three distinct C-derived options rather than one refined C artifact.

criteria.name: shared-baseline
criteria.description: Every option preserves the watcher and applies the requested board-health, plot-header, and copy changes.

criteria.name: continued-exploration
criteria.description: The follow-up asks the user to choose among the new branches rather than asking for final approval.
